name: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Ltd
title: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Ltd - 511243 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Vehicle finance recovery showing up in April collections: early defaults and non-starters lower than April 2025, with FY27 credit cost guided to ~1.5% from 1.6% pre-overlay and a INR200 crore overlay held as buffer.

utilisation.quote: better capacity utilization of the vehicles

triggers.label: April early defaults lower YoY
triggers.quote: early defaults and non-starter accounts are significantly lower in April 2026 compared to April 2025

triggers.label: Vehicle finance growth across segments in April
triggers.quote: As of April, we have recorded growth across all segments.

triggers.label: FY27 credit cost ~1.5% from 1.6%
triggers.quote: We are also expecting our net credit cost to decline from 1.6% pre-overlay to around 1.5%

triggers.label: Competitive intensity from banks unchanged
triggers.quote: We have not observed any significant change in competitive behavior over the past four to five months.

guidance.quote: For this financial year, we continue to maintain our committed growth trajectory of 20% to 23%.
We are also expecting our net credit cost to decline from 1.6% pre-overlay to around 1.5%
we are guiding towards disbursement growth of around 15% to 20% and asset growth of approximately 18%.
our return on assets should improve, moving closer to a pre-tax ROA of 3.5%, as previously discussed.
we expect operating expenses to remain around 3% of average assets on an overall basis.
we expect NIMs to hold at approximately the 8% level.
We are planning to open around 60 new branches in Q1 and another 40 branches in Q2
we believe that pretax ROA should comfortably cross 3% during the current financial year.
Gold loan is adding 360 more. Today we are at 119.

prior_guidance_check.quote: AUM growth remained healthy at 21% as at the end of the quarter

red_flags.label: Management overlay INR200 crore for war/fuel risk
red_flags.quote: the company has provided a management overlay for INR200 crores as a precautionary buffer

red_flags.label: Gearing 6.94x and capital raise optionality
red_flags.quote: If our Tier 1 ratio were to approach 13%, we would certainly begin evaluating equity-raising options.

red_flags.label: Home loan disbursements flat for 7-8 quarters
red_flags.quote: It's been in this INR1,800 crores, INR2,000 crores range for now 7, 8 quarters.

evasions.topic: Collection and bounce rate detail by segment
evasions.quote: I can't give you business data. These are not in the public domain.
So maybe we'll come back after seeing the number.
